'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[American Rescue Plan Act of 2021]]
***The [[United States Senate]] votes 50–49 to pass [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]]'s [[United States dollar|$]]1.9 trillion [[American Rescue Plan Act of 2021|relief package]] after 24 hours of debate and [[vote-a-rama]] sessions on the bill. The amended legislation will head back to the [[United States House of Representatives]] for a final vote. '''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
*****[[14th Dalai Lama|Tenzin Gyatso, the 14th Dalai Lama]], receives a dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] in [[Dharamshala]], [[Himachal Pradesh]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/tibetan-govt-in-exile-requests-dalai-lama-s-covid-19-vaccination-101614760997828-amp.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
*****[[Moderna]] signs a supply deal with the [[Government of the Philippines|government]] to supply 13 million doses of its [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|COVID-19 vaccine]] from mid-2021. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/moderna-philippines-covid-19-vaccine-13-million-doses-14352628 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brunei]]
****The [[Government of Brunei|government]] announces that it will ease their [[social distancing]] measures when [[Brunei]] enters a "New Normal" phase on March 8 as the country has reported no community cases in the last 300 days. [https://thescoop.co/2021/03/06/brunei-to-ease-more-covid-19-curbs-in-new-normal-phase-on-march-8/ (The Scoop)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] confirms that it will ease [[COVID-19]]-related restrictions in entertainment and events and will reopen cinemas, gyms, and sport centres beginning on March 7. [https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/saudi/saudi-arabia-to-ease-covid-19-restrictions-starting-sunday-1.1614999485988 (Gulf News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Republic of Ireland]]
*****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] reaches a milestone of 500,000 doses of the COVID-19 vaccine administered. [https://www.irishpost.com/news/taoiseach-confirms-good-news-that-ireland-has-administered-over-500000-vaccination-doses-205544 (''The Irish Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[Government of France|French authorities]] extend their weekend [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] to the  northern region of [[Pas-de-Calais]], prompting hundreds of thousands of people to stay at home on Saturdays and Sundays due to the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/france-extends-weekend-lockdown-to-northern-region (RFI)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malawi]]
****[[Malawi]] receives its first shipment of 360,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine through the [[COVAX]] vaccine-sharing initiative. [https://www.voanews.com/covid-19-pandemic/malawi-receives-first-covid-vaccine-shipment (VOA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nigeria]]
****[[President of Nigeria|President]] [[Muhammadu Buhari]] and [[Vice President of Nigeria|Vice President]] [[Yemi Osinbajo]] receive their first doses of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/56304630.amp (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
***[[Fiji]] receives its first shipment of 12,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] vaccine through the COVAX vaccine-sharing initiative. [https://www.fbcnews.com.fj/news/covid-19/covid-19-vaccine-arrive-in-nadi/ (FBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela]]
***[[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] and his wife [[Cilia Flores]] receive their first doses of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210306-venezuela-s-maduro-receives-first-dose-of-russian-vaccine (France 24)]
*[[China]] confirms an outbreak of the [[African swine fever]] in the key pork-producing [[provinces of China|provinces]] of [[Hubei]] and [[Sichuan]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/china-confirms-african-swine-fever-outbreaks-in-sichuan-hubei-provinces (''The Straits Times'')]
